canonical-witness-pinned.evidence: QA re-refresh of #8917 at 8e1db9fdd0d. The remark evaluates at the muon pin q0 = 1.109978595642739 (16 dps). da-false-claim.evidence: QA re-refresh of #8917 at 8e1db9fdd0d. The comparison numbers do not match a 30-dps recomputation or the block's own witness (computations/probes/flavor-split-substrate-probe.witness.json, relative error 1.277e-3). At q0 = 1.1099785956 (and equally at the proton pin): (q0-1)^2(1-q0^-4)/3 = 1.37571e-3 against CODATA 1.29333251/938.918756 = 1.37747e-3, residual -0.128%, not -0.10%. Intermediate: q0^-4 = 0.65878 and 1-q0^-4 = 0.34122, not 0.6585 and 0.3415. Row 3: M_N times the formula = 1.2917 MeV (1.29168 with M_N = 938.92), residual -0.13%, not 1.287 MeV and -0.52%. Row 2: with mu_avg = M_N/3 (Step 6 of the proof) the CODATA value is 4.1324e-3 and the residual -0.13%; the stated 4.148e-3 implies mu_avg = 311.75 MeV, the fitted dressed masses, which contradicts Step 6. The same numbers stood in the statement block on main, unflagged there; they now sit at the comparison point this PR creates, which is where the empirical claim lives. Not fixed here.

QA re-check of #8917 at b87258043bb. Recomputed independently with mpmath at 50 dps, proton pin q0 = 1.10997858275138080759166909561 (qou_substrate.constants.q_at), CODATA 2022 from qou_substrate.codata (m_p 938.27208943, m_n 939.56542194, M_N = 938.918755685 MeV): (q0-1)^2 = 0.0120953, 1-q0^-4 = 0.341218, formula = 1.37571e-3 against (m_n-m_p)/M_N = 1.37747e-3, residual -0.12772 %; row 2 with mu_avg = M_N/3 (Step 6): 4.12713e-3 against 4.13241e-3, -0.12772 %; row 3: 1.29168 MeV against 1.29333 MeV, -0.12772 %. Every figure in the remark matches to the digits shown. The block witness (computations/probes/flavor-split-substrate-probe.witness.json) records the same q0, delta_pred 1.375711e-3 and rel_error -0.127708 %; it uses CODATA-2018 masses (938.27208816 / 939.56542052), which moves the residual only in the fifth digit. Resolves the earlier major fail. The statement that the three rows carry one residual is correct (they differ by the factors 3 and M_N).
